facts.value: Dispatches B pressed-button input to the fighter-kind-specific aerial up, down, side, or neutral special callback, with guarded pre-dispatch facing adjustments. Returns true after an available callback returns and x2227_b5 is set; returns false for absent B or an unavailable selected callback. It does not itself test ground/air state or clear the input bit.
facts.rationale: Replace ambiguous consumption wording with the independently verified local contract.

evidence.why: Complete input gate, callback selection, mutations and returns.

facts.value: Requires HSD_PAD_B in input.pressed_buttons. Priority is Y >= common x21C for Hi, Y <= -x21C for Lw, ABS(X) >= x218 for S, then N. A NULL selected callback rejects immediately without fallback. With an available S callback, X*facing_dir < -x220 invokes ftCommon_UpdateFacing, which assigns +1 for nonnegative X and -1 otherwise. With an available N callback, x676_x < x224 and either (facing_dir == -1 && x2228_b7 == 1) or (facing_dir == +1 && x2228_b7 == 0) causes direct facing negation. Each selected callback receives gobj, then the cached Fighter pointer's x2227_b5 is set true and true is returned. False paths do not clear x2227_b5.
facts.rationale: Replace the stale input alias and implicit direction-protocol inference with exact guards, inclusive selection boundaries, strict facing boundaries, and post-callback ordering.

evidence.why: All branch conditions, NULL rejection paths, callbacks and local mutations are explicit.
The helper assigns facing from the comparison of X with zero.
